chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Sa'id narrated to us, saying: Ali ibn al-Hasan narrated to us, from his father, from Ahmad ibn Umar al-Halabi, from al-Husayn ibn Musa, from Fudayl ibn Muhammad, the freed slave of Muhammad ibn Rashid al-Bajali, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) that he said:
Indeed, the call from the heaven by the name of the Qa'im is clear in the Book of Allah.
I said: 'Where is it? May Allah rectify you?'
He said: 'It is in [the verse]: "If We please, We should send down upon them a sign from the heaven so that their necks should stoop to it."'
He said: 'When they hear the voice, they will become as if there are birds on their heads.'

key_terms.آيَةً: A sign, a miraculous event or phenomenon
key_terms.أَعْنَاقُهُمْ: Their necks, symbolizing submission or bowing
key_terms.الصَّوْتُ: The voice, referring to the audible call from heaven
key_terms.النِّدَاءُ: The call, specifically the divine announcement from heaven
key_terms.الْقَائِمُ: The Qa'im (The Riser), a title for the Twelfth Imam, Muhammad al-Mahdi

ai.seo_question: Which Quranic verse indicates the call of the Qa'im from heaven?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) identifies the call of the Qa'im (the Awaited One) in the Quran, specifically citing the verse from Surah Az-Zukhruf where a sign from heaven causes people's necks to bow in submission. The narration explains that upon hearing this divine call, people will be struck with such astonishment and confusion that they will appear as if birds are perched on their heads. This interpretation is rooted in Shia exegetical tradition, which views the 'sign from heaven' as the audible proclamation of the Mahdi's authority, marking the transition from occultation to public appearance.

en.abdullah-al-shahin: (23) Ahmad bin Muhammad bin Sa’eed narrated from Ali bin al-Hasan from his father from Ahmad bin Umar al-Halabi from al-Husayn bin Musa from Fudhayl bin Muhammad, the freed slave of Muhammad bin Rashid al-Bajali that Abu Abdullah as-Sadiq (as) had said:
“The call coming from the Heaven and calling out the name of al-Qa’im is clear in the Book of Allah.”
He was asked: “Where is it in the Book of Allah?”
He said: “Allah has said, ‘If We please, We should send down upon them a sign from the heaven so that their necks should stoop to it.’
When people hear the call, they will become as if there are birds on their heads (because of astonishment and confusion).”
